dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: I watered down every drink I ever poured. Every one. Thirty years.

dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: Nobody ever asked me why. I'd have told them: I was scared the money would run out. It always felt like it would.

dialogue.speaker: Dolores Marrow
dialogue.text: Don't look at me like that. I don't need pity. ...But thanks for not walking out.
